summary_en: This study tests several drugs, including durvalumab, toripalimab, BA3011, BA3021 and ENB003, in platinum resistant high grade serous ovarian cancer. The drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and durvalumab is given as 1500 mg over 60 minutes on day 1 every 4 weeks; the schedules for the other drugs are not stated. The record does not state the main outcome measured; the study is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba varios medicamentos, entre ellos durvalumab, toripalimab, BA3011, BA3021 y ENB003, en el cáncer de ovario seroso de alto grado resistente al platino. Los medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV), y durvalumab se administra como 1500 mg durante 60 minutos el día 1 cada 4 semanas; los esquemas de los otros medicamentos no se indican. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide; el estudio es un ensayo de Fase 2.
who_for: Women with platinum resistant high grade serous ovarian, fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer
Disease progressed within 6 months of last platinum-containing chemotherapy
Measurable disease as defined by RECIST 1.1
ECOG performance status 0 or 1 and life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Symptomatic uncontrolled brain metastases requiring corticosteroid treatment
Active or past autoimmune or inflammatory disorder within the past 3 years, with some exceptions
Significant cardiac disease within 6 months, or QTc above 470 msec (450 msec with added risk factors)
History of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis
